text:
maya: rolling release v2026.3 -> canary (region: us-west2). deploy-bot kicked off at 11:02PT. will watch quick smoke (3m). tagging release_notes: brief perf tweaks + embed cache fix.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: job/ignite-canary-3276543210. pods 2->2, image: redwood/inference:2026.3-canary. logs streaming.
kevin: watching embed route p95 — already trending up from 120ms -> 270ms on a small sample. not sure if bursty or sustained.
li: running the synthetic probe suite against canary endpoint now (small sample, 30 requests). will paste failures if any.
ops_sara: FYI i'm on call till 2pm PT, if we need to pin/rollback call me. change window still open for another 45m.
li: synth probe results: 30/30 requests returned, but 4/30 had server-side errors in the body: 
```
{ "status": 503, "route": "/v1/embeds", "error": "kv-cache-miss-timeout" }
```
kevin: 4/30 c500s seems high for canary. p95 heatmap shows spikes correlated with cache warmups.
oncall-bot: Alert: canary-synth-failures > threshold (3) — paging channel.
maya: ok, let's hold the rollout. decision options: 1) pin canary to previous image (rollback) 2) keep canary but reduce traffic to 10% and increase prefill for kv-cache 3) accept and monitor (risk). any opinions?
li: we can try option 2 quickly: throttle traffic and run a small prefill job to warm KV for canary nodes. that should reduce 503 due to miss timeout. prefill script is fast (~30s).
kevin: agree with 2. metrics suggest warmup-sensitive regressions, not functional failures. patch for prefill queued.
ops_sara: if prefill doesn't drop errors below 1/30 in 5m, we should roll back. set rollback timer 10m.
maya: action: reduce canary traffic to 10% (done), trigger prefill (started), increasing synthetic cadence to 2x for next 5m. recording in release notes: "canary paused, warming KV cache; monitoring p95 & synth errors."
li: prefill completed. re-running synth: 30/30 OK, 0 errors. p95 back to ~130ms.
kevin: solid. remove hold?
maya: we'll keep 10% for another 10m then ramp to 50% if stable, then full. rollback timer cancelled per ops_sara.
ops_sara: noted. I'll update the change window doc and add the postdeploy blurb for the release notes. :white_check_mark:
kevin: also adding a quick note to the runbook: if cache warmup causes >2/30 synth errors, throttle to 5% and trigger automated prefill.
maya: thanks team. closing handoff — will follow up in the postdeploy verification doc with charts.
deploy-bot: Canary job health: OK. canary-traffic 10% -> scheduled ramp at +10m."
